summary: A Yes vote enacts a $168-per-parcel tax for eight years, raising about $6 million per year for the district's academic programs and teacher recruitment, with a senior exemption.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes the district to levy a $168 parcel tax for eight years to provide approximately $6 million annually in local school funding.
tax.quote: with Acalanes Union High School District levying a $168 parcel tax for eight years, with senior exemptions, citizens' oversight and independent audits, providing $6,000,000 annually in local school funding that cannot be taken by the State, be adopted?

schools.text: A Yes vote authorizes funding for educational programs and services in the district's public schools.
schools.quote: By approval of this proposition (the "Measure") by at least two-thirds of the registered voters voting on the proposition, the District will be authorized to levy an education parcel tax of $168 per parcel for eight years, to maintain a high-quality education in District schools, subject to the accountability requirements specified below.
